spec.description: nav-pilot CLI telemetry: adoption and rollout, reliability, and sync freshness. Queries tolerate missing data during rollout.

Command runs per interval. Each sample is what is new since the process's last export, and all runs on a machine share a series, so rate()/increase() give 0. sum_over_time() counts each run once. Long sessions from versions before #1246 are counted once per export (every 10 seconds).
spec.title: Command runs per interval

spec.description: Errors per command per interval. Empty means no errors reported (expected).
spec.title: Errors by command

spec.description: Conflicts found during sync. Should be low; suitable for alerting.
spec.title: Sync conflicts by scope

spec.description: Average share of runs where the component was up to date (1 = up to date).
spec.title: Up-to-date share by component

spec.description: Actual freshness verdicts. Non-verdict outcomes (dev, no_install, cooldown) are excluded to highlight up_to_date/stale/lookup_failed/corrupted. Adoption and install have their own panels.
spec.title: Freshness verdict (up-to-date / stale)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (command, le) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_command_duration_ms_bucket{version=~"$version", execution_context=~"$execution_context", command=~"$command", scope=~"$scope"}[$__range])))

spec.description: P95 duration. The _bucket suffix assumes the standard OTLP-to-Prometheus mapping.
spec.title: Command latency p95 by command

spec.description: Share of all active machines (last interval) with RTK installed.
spec.title: RTK adoption (all known machines)

spec.expr: 100 * sum(sum_over_time(nav_pilot_command_error_total{version=~"$version", execution_context=~"$execution_context", command=~"$command", scope=~"$scope"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(nav_pilot_command_duration_ms_count{version=~"$version", execution_context=~"$execution_context", command=~"$command", scope=~"$scope"}[$__range])), 1)

spec.description: Daily active devices by version (DAU). Shows how new versions replace old ones as they roll out.
spec.title: Adoption by version (rolling 24 h)

spec.description: Split of command runs between interactive use (organic) and CI.
spec.title: Organic vs CI

spec.description: Skills loaded by Copilot sessions started with nav-pilot. Nav's skills are named, others are named other.
spec.title: Skills loaded in Copilot sessions (range)

spec.description: Calls to Copilot's built-in tools, with outcome. Other tools are named other.
spec.title: Tool calls in Copilot sessions (range)

spec.description: Tokens by model and type, read from Copilot's session log when the session ends.
spec.title: Tokens by model in Copilot sessions (range)

spec.description: Premium requests by model, read from Copilot's session log when the session ends.
spec.title: Premium requests by model in Copilot sessions (range)

spec.description: Hook runs in Copilot sessions, by hook type and outcome.
spec.title: Hook runs by type and outcome (range)

spec.expr: 100 * (sum by (hook_type) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_session_hook_runs_total{version=~"$version", outcome="error"}[$__range])) or sum by (hook_type) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_session_hook_runs_total{version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (hook_type) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_session_hook_runs_total{version=~"$version"}[$__range])), 1)

spec.description: Share of hook runs with outcome error, by hook type.
spec.title: Hook error rate by type

spec.expr: 100 * (sum by (client, tool) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_session_tool_calls_total{version=~"$version", outcome="error"}[$__range])) or sum by (client, tool) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_session_tool_calls_total{version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (client, tool) (sum_over_time(nav_pilot_session_tool_calls_total{version=~"$version"}[$__range])), 1)

spec.description: Share of tool calls with outcome error, by tool. Other tools are named other.
spec.title: Error rate by tool

spec.description: Subagents chosen by Copilot sessions. Other agents are named other.
spec.title: Subagents chosen (range)

spec.description: Model responses per Copilot session.
spec.title: Turns per session, p50 and p95

spec.description: How long a Copilot session lasted, by how it ended.
spec.title: Session length by shutdown type, p50 and p95

spec.description: Time a Copilot session waited on the model API, by model.
spec.title: Model API wait by model, p50 and p95

spec.description: Lines in Copilot's events.jsonl that nav-pilot could not read. A rising count probably means Copilot changed the format.
spec.title: Lines skipped in events.jsonl (range)
nav-pilot CLI (nais)

spec.label: Metrics
spec.name: DS_METRICS
spec.description: Mimir data source with X-Scope-OrgID nais. nav-pilot telemetry exists only in the nais org; import this dashboard into the Grafana that reads it.
